newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trotman has no comment on Ford succession.
newsitem.headline: Trotman has no comment on Ford succession.

text.p: The chairman and chief executive of Ford Motor Co said on Monday he would not comment on speculation about his succession.
"I'm not going to comment at all on any aspects of the succession dicussions that have been in the newspapers recently," Alex Trotman told Reuters Financial Television.

Fortune Magazine reported in its October issue that the Ford board had asked Trotman to stay on past his 65th birthday in July 1998 and that 39-year-old William Clay Ford Jr was a candidate for succession.

Fortune said Edward Hagenlocker, seen by many as next in line, would be bypassed and also replaced in his post as president of Ford Automotive Operations by Jacques Nasser, the company's product development chief.
Ford last week denied the report.
